prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a substantially WIDER horizontal version of this exact five-character transparent hero group. Preserve these five identities, material quality, faces and lighting. Do not merely add empty canvas. The ACTUAL VISIBLE CHARACTERS must together form a wide, low silhouette about 1.6 times as wide as tall. Render on a 3:2 LANDSCAPE transparent canvas with characters filling 90–94% of canvas width and 84–90% of its height, with only 3–5% clear alpha safety margin. NO empty half of the picture.
Rearrange and resize the five actors using this layout:
1. Large PURPLE plush Dots sphere, black paired oval eyes and silver/lilac connected headphones, at foreground LEFT. Its diameter is 65–70% of the whole group's visible height. It dominates the left HALF. NO mouth, nose, hands, arms, legs.
2. Same original chestnut-haired cheerful chibi boy in mint/teal knit cardigan, behind and immediately RIGHT of that large sphere, not sitting on top of it. The boy's huge head is 50–55% of total group height. Boy head top is only a little above headphone top; his face beside the upper-right quadrant of sphere, not a full head vertically above it. Boy's short torso is concealed behind sphere and companions. One hand naturally rests on the headphone edge, the other is a small friendly wave beside his cheek, all fingers plausible.
3. Small green Grok cloud occupies lower INNER-RIGHT beside the boy and sphere, 30% of group height, smooth matte silicone.
4. Small blue Grok teardrop peeks at the far INNER-RIGHT just behind cloud, 25% of group height. These two geometries extend the huddle to the RIGHT, not upward above boy.
5. Tiny rose-pink plush Dots sphere at front edge between purple sphere and cloud, 20% of group height.
Both Groks have exactly two parallel WHITE capsule eyes tilted like backslash, no mouth and no limbs. Pink Dots has two BLACK oval eyes and no mouth or limbs.
Composition: two strong side-by-side main masses (big purple sphere LEFT, big boy head RIGHT) at similar top levels, with three little companions completing the right side. A wide crescent-shaped tightly connected group. All faces readable. Gently overlapping, touching and sharing a common lower baseline. Entire visible silhouette close to 1.6:1; NOT the tall triangular tower of the reference. Do not make person body tall. Full group fully inside canvas including headphone cups and waving hand.
Premium fine short plush fibers for Dots, detailed directional boy hair and knit fabric, matte silicone Groks; soft unified front-upper-left light. True transparent RGBA. No background, backdrop, haze, floor, pedestal, independent ground shadow, text, UI, watermark or logo.

Edit the supplied five-character transparent cutout. Preserve the exact characters, count, identities, gestures, fine hair, plush, silicone, materials, lighting and friendly expressions.
Make only a framing/composition correction: move the blue teardrop and green cloud slightly closer inward toward the boy, narrowing the full character-group silhouette from about 1.72:1 to about 1.62:1. Keep all five faces clear. Do not deform or horizontally squash any character. The purple headphones sphere stays at left, boy beside it at right, tiny pink sphere front, cloud and droplet inner-right.
Scale and center the complete corrected cutout so every outside edge has 4% genuinely EMPTY transparent safety margin. Fill around 90–92% of canvas width and 88–92% of height; final canvas landscape about 1.6:1. Do not crop the headphone, blue droplet, hair, waving hand or sphere. No half-empty canvas.
This is a transparent sticker asset. Actual RGBA alpha 0 outside the character silhouettes, no backdrop, haze, glow, floor, cast shadow, text, logo, UI or watermark.
